value: 23.5% of all views carry no annotation at all: every GT 2D joint is exactly (0,0) while confidence is reported as 1.0, which is an undetected-hand sentinel rather than a measurement. Among the remaining bad views 84% fail as a whole view (>90% of joints over 50 px), and 519 frames have exactly one hand sentinel while the other is annotated, so the failure follows the hand/view rather than the camera geometry.
